comment: A running CodeSpace session's transcript survives a host restart: while a session provably runs, the Connection Owner mirrors its events.jsonl (whole lines, by byte offset) to the host and pushes it into the agent-logger hub under its own .codespaces-live/<name> label (never over the close-out capture's .codespaces/<name>); a failed or partial push is retried until it lands whole, across restarts and after the session ends, without contacting the box (an otherwise idle Owner stays up to an hour for it); deleting a CodeSpace removes its local mirror once the hub copy is current, then or on a later retry. agent-logger's session-fetch finds sessions under both labels, preferring the close-out copy. AGENT_CODESPACES_TRANSCRIPT_MIRROR=0 turns the mirror off.
